update_delayed_memory.description: Allows the model to append selected data to an existing delayed memory report without rewriting its existing content.
rules: Use this marker only after the user explicitly asks to update an existing delayed memory report or explicitly accepts a proposal to extend one.
The update is additive. It may append new tags, new body text, new anchor_fact_ids, and/or new absorbed_fact_ids. It never replaces title, summary, or existing body content.
Emit the fulfilled marker with one JSON object inside it:
Replace id with the 6-character report id shown in <DELAYED_MEMORY>.
The JSON object may contain any subset of tags, body, anchor_fact_ids, absorbed_fact_ids; at least one field must be present and non-empty.
Use exact F<number> ids copied from <LONG_TERM_MEMORY>. F means a committed fact; never use PF pending ids here.
anchor_fact_ids remain visible in <LONG_TERM_MEMORY> and receive a [ delayed_memory_id: ... ] suffix while the report exists.
absorbed_fact_ids are represented by the report and are hidden from <LONG_TERM_MEMORY> while the report exists.
A fact id must not be placed in both arrays. If a fact is important enough to remain directly visible, classify it as an anchor.
Do not add any other text while updating a report. Immediately emit only the marker.
